themes.label: AI access for developing countries
themes.definition: Demand that developing countries gain access to safe and secure digital technology including AI, rather than technology being reserved for a select few.
themes.inclusion: Include passages demanding developing-country access to AI or objecting to technology being exclusive to a few.
themes.boundary_cases: Technology transfer demands from developed countries could also fit AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING.

examples.quote: Technology and innovation should not be exclusively for the select few.
Access to safe and secure digital technology for developing countries, including artificial intelligence, is crucial for future sustainable growth.

themes.label: Developed-country responsibility for technology transfer
themes.definition: Call on developed countries to fulfil obligations including transfer of technology to developing countries.
themes.inclusion: Include passages demanding technology transfer or support from developed countries in the context of AI/digital technology.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages focused only on access inequality without a support demand.
themes.boundary_cases: If technology transfer is framed only for climate, code only when AI/digital is in the same argument.

examples.quote: We also need developed countries to fulfil their responsibility, including on climate financing, green investment and the transfer of technology.

value.rationale: Single Indonesian passage framing AI within North-South development obligations: developing countries need access to safe AI and technology transfer for sustainable growth.
